title: Aixion Control Tower
coreClaim: I build approval infrastructure for AI-agent execution.
problem: AI agents need human approval before executing risky work.
whyItMatters: Without approval infrastructure, autonomous agents either become risky or useless.
myRole: I shaped the product scope around mobile approval and controlled execution.
I defined the approval lifecycle, payload integrity requirement, and MCP wait-mode proof target.
I pushed the work toward tests, auditability, and real forward-after-approval behavior instead of cosmetic UI.
proofGaps: A polished live demo still needs to show blocked -> approved -> forwarded execution end to end.
nextProofTarget: Record a working MCP gateway wait-mode demo with side-channel approval and child-server forwarding proof.

title: MCP Shield
coreClaim: I design safety layers for AI tool-call workflows.
problem: MCP servers expose powerful tools, but unsafe tool calls need policy, auditability, and control before execution.
whyItMatters: As AI agents gain tool access, the risk shifts from answers to actions. Tool calls need safety gates, not blind trust.
myRole: I shaped the product around gateway control, mutating-call detection, safe alternatives, and audit trails.
I treated policy, release hardening, and malicious server testing as MVP requirements.
I kept the scope focused on proving control instead of adding generic security claims.
proofGaps: Needs a clean real-client demo with Claude Desktop or Cursor.
Needs stronger public proof around malicious server corpus and policy matrix tests.
nextProofTarget: Create a demo showing blocked mutating call, safe alternative suggestion, approval, and audited forwarding.

title: Tradebot
coreClaim: I debug automation systems where failure hides between signal, integration, and execution.
problem: The bot generated signals but did not execute trades reliably.
whyItMatters: A trading system is worthless if strategy output cannot map to executable broker contracts and stable live data.
myRole: I investigated the failure beyond surface-level strategy assumptions.
I identified contract resolution as a core execution blocker.
I focused the system toward executable symbols, feed stability, gating, and diagnostics.
proofGaps: Needs cleaner public demo evidence that avoids exposing sensitive trading configuration.
nextProofTarget: Create a safe redacted before/after execution-diagnostics case study.

title: RTI App
coreClaim: I design civic-tech workflows that make legal and public processes easier for normal users.
problem: Common citizens struggle to frame RTI questions, identify departments, and understand filing boundaries.
whyItMatters: A civic product must simplify access without giving reckless legal advice or pretending automation can replace human review.
myRole: I identified the user pain and shaped the MVP around guided drafting, templates, and review boundaries.
proofGaps: Needs product bible, wireframes, prototype, and legal-risk boundary documentation.
nextProofTarget: Write RTI App MVP scope with guided questionnaire and human review flow.

title: TabLock Guard / TabGuard WorkLock
coreClaim: I build focused productivity tools that solve real workflow friction.
problem: Browser-heavy users lose focus, switch windows accidentally, or struggle with Chrome multi-window behavior on Mac.
whyItMatters: Small workflow utilities can create serious daily value when they solve one painful behavior clearly.
myRole: I shaped the idea around tab/window locking, user-selected protected tabs, and optional Mac workflow support.
proofGaps: Needs extension architecture, Chrome API feasibility check, and prototype.
nextProofTarget: Write extension scope and build a minimal protected-tab prototype.

title: Job Application Agent
coreClaim: I design AI workflow assistants that prepare high-quality output while keeping humans in control.
problem: Job applications need tailored material, but reckless auto-apply bots create quality and trust problems.
whyItMatters: The valuable automation is preparation, scoring, tailoring, and approval—not blindly clicking submit.
myRole: I shaped the system around fit scoring, resume tailoring, application packs, and human approval before submission.
proofGaps: Needs prototype and sample evidence packs.
nextProofTarget: Create a sample QA Automation and AI Safety evidence pack from real project proof.
